provider: Google for Startups Cloud Program (Start / Scale tiers)

free_tier.stated: Scale and Scale AI tiers: '$200K - $350k in credits' for startups with verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A funding. Credits apply to 'most Google Cloud platform products ... used in a pay-as-you-go (PayG) or consumption billed format' — which includes Cloud Storage buckets.

egress.terms: GCP egress is metered and comes out of the same credit pool; free egress only to Cloudflare-class partners or via the always-free 200 GB/mo Cloud Storage egress allowance.

tooling: rclone backend 'gcs' (Tier 1), gsutil, GCS XML/JSON API, GCS interop keys give an S3-compatible endpoint.
chaining: Credits are per billing account and explicitly non-transferable ('Credits may only be used by the original applicant and cannot be shared, split, or resold'). The multiplier is *re-application in later years* — Google allows re-applying if credits went unused ('You may still be eligible for credits if you did not use your credits in a previous enrollment'). $200K at coldline-class rates is petabyte-scale for a year; the binding constraint becomes the 12-month expiry, not bytes.
limits_note: per-object-cap: GCS single-object max 5 TiB — not binding. request-rate: per-project GCS quotas (raiseable). retention: credits are time-boxed (program is annual, 'Program qualifications change annually'). Excludes educational institutions, government, nonprofits, personal blogs/content, dev shops and consultancies — a startup wrapper is required.
reliability_note: Requires a funded company, a matching domain email and a billing account owned by that domain; credits land in a specific billing account ID and cannot be moved afterwards. Year-over-year re-enrolment is not guaranteed.

evidence.proved: 'Our Funded program tiers (Scale, and Scale AI) range from $200K - $350k in credits'; exclusion list; 'Credits may only be used by the original applicant'
'Can I re-apply if I participated in this program a few years ago but did not use my credits? You may still be eligible ... if you did not use your credits'

notes: Scale and Scale AI tiers: '$200K - $350k in credits' for startups with verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A funding. Credits apply to 'most Google Cloud platform products ... used in a pay-as-you-go (PayG) or consumption billed format' — which includes Cloud Storage buckets.
binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
